items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: there’s The Spitfires, there’s Brigham Phyllis big band.

ctx.x: Is there a big band scene still in Toronto or is it kind of an effort to mount every performance?

It’s tough to get the bands playing because of the practical aspect of it. It’s more difficult, it’s more expensive to hire seventeen pieces, but there are, in Toronto, several really good big bands. There’s Boss Brass of course which comes from there, and at the other end of the spectrum playing in this style is my own band, but in between there’s Dave McMurdo has a very good band, there’s quite a successful if somewhat commercial big band I attribute the Glenn Miller band, but it’s getting work and there’s The…
Good. These jazz parties that you come to, do they have such a thing in Canada?
